_comment: Template for seed.local.json (which is gitignored so real commute data never lands on public GitHub Pages). Copy this to seed.local.json and replace the rows. Segment value null = did not happen / was not recorded and exports blank; 0 = happened and measured ~nil and exports 0.00. 'order' is the actual segment sequence. Set incomplete:true when the trip wasn't fully recorded — arrive and door2door then export blank.
